summary: Tested (1) the owner GPS screen redesign (/agents-map, 390x844) and (2) the developer delete tools on the live Convex backend fearless-ostrich-878. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass (test_dev_delete_powers.py), covering RBAC for owner and agent on all 6 /dev delete routes, rejection of a wrong hard-delete confirm, soft delete + restore of org_test_1, plan create/delete/audit, the three user-delete guards, and deletion of a payment request with its audit entry. Frontend GPS: stats tiles, empty state, map with marker, legend, search and the 4 filter chips (36px tall, laid out in one horizontal row) all work. agent-location row opens AgentMapSheet, the no-location row renders, the 'خطوط سير اليوم' tab works, and there were 0 page errors. Frontend dev: org-danger-zone shows the 3 buttons. The hard-delete confirm sheet explains the consequences, and the button stays disabled until the exact org name is typed (it was NOT confirmed). The delete-request-button opens a confirm sheet. delete-plan-button deleted a TEST plan end-to-end. org_test_1 was restored to ACTIVE and verified ACTIVE at the end. One real gap: a soft-deleted org can be re-activated through billing, and its owner sees a misleading 'subscription expired' screen.

critical.issue: A soft-deleted (DELETED) org is still reachable through billing routes, because require(..., {billing:true}) only checks the role. Verified: with org_test_1 DELETED, the owner got 200 from GET /upgrade-requests, /plans and /payment-methods, and the app sent the owner to /blocked showing 'انتهى اشتراك المؤسسة. يرجى التجديد' with a renew CTA. The owner can submit a payment request. Approving it (billing.ts:558), devAssignPlan (billing.ts:604) or the unfreeze/resume actions (subscription.ts:123/131) set status ACTIVE without any DELETED check, which silently undoes the soft delete.

minor.issue: Restore always sets status ACTIVE (devAdmin.ts:88), so the org's previous status (SUSPENDED/FROZEN/EXPIRED/GRACE) is lost. Restoring a suspended or frozen org un-suspends it. The previous status should be stored on soft delete and restored from it.

This is a code review only; the endpoint was not run. The patch sets status ACTIVE for anything that is not DELETED (devAdmin.ts:151), so cancelling the subscription of a SUSPENDED org lifts the suspension. It should keep SUSPENDED. There is also a redundant getUser() call before require().

Each batch does .filter(org_id) over the whole table with no index (devAdmin.ts:28), and each row costs a full-table scan. On large tables this can hit Convex per-transaction read limits partway through. The delete is not atomic, so a failure leaves the org half-purged. Use the by_org indexes where they exist.

licenses.org_id (schema has org_id on licenses) is not cleared or deleted, which leaves a dangling org reference. Members' notifications and sessions are kept, which is acceptable because accounts survive.

Orgs on the deleted plan keep plan_id pointing at a plan that no longer exists. The response returns orgs_on_plan but the UI gives no warning when that count is > 0. Any renewal or upgrade code that looks up the plan by org.plan_id should handle the missing plan.
Only distributor_inventory and the user's auth rows are cleaned. agent_locations, routes and sales_targets rows for that user_id stay behind as orphans.

ui_bugs.component: Blocked screen for a soft-deleted org
ui_bugs.issue: The owner of a DELETED org sees 'انتهى اشتراك المؤسسة… يرجى التجديد' plus a renew button. The message should say the org was deleted or disabled by the administrator, and the renew CTA should be hidden.

issues: The status Badge ('متصل الآن' / 'غير متصل') is drawn in its own row above each AgentLocationRow card and looks detached from it. Put the badge inside the card header.
The legend row ('اضغط على أي موزع لعرض مساره') still shows when there is no map (empty state). Hide it when html is null.
In the gps-search-input placeholder the Arabic text looks wrongly shaped and spaced ('...ا بحث عن موزع') in the web preview.
The live caption 'مباشر · تحديث تلقائي كل دقيقة · آخر تحديث…' is cut off at 390px.

action_items: Block DELETED orgs on billing routes. In lib.require with billing:true, throw when org.status === 'DELETED'. Also add DELETED guards to approve (billing.ts:558), devAssignPlan (billing.ts:604) and the devSubAction resume/unfreeze actions, so nothing except softDeleteOrg{restore} can re-activate a deleted org.
On /blocked, show a 'deleted by administrator' message with no renew CTA when org.status === 'DELETED'.
softDeleteOrg: save prev_status on delete and restore to it instead of always setting ACTIVE.
cancelSubscription: keep SUSPENDED (and DELETED) status; only change ACTIVE/EXPIRED/GRACE/FROZEN to ACTIVE-Free.
purgeBatch: use the by_org index (withIndex) instead of a full-table .filter, to avoid read limits on large orgs. Also clean licenses with this org_id.
deleteUser: also purge agent_locations, routes and sales_targets for the user_id.
Optional: fix the stale comments in devAdmin.ts that say 'DELETE /api/dev/orgs/:id?mode=hard'; the actual route is POST /dev/orgs/:id/delete.
critical_code_review_comments: Every exported devAdmin function goes through require(..., DEV). The internal mutations also re-check DEV (checkOrg, finishOrgDelete), and purgeBatch is internal-only. Confirmed: owner and agent get 'ليس لديك صلاحية'.

Hard delete covers all 25 org tables (all schema tables with org_id except users, licenses, payment_methods.org_ids, billing_ledger and audit_logs). It deletes receipt storage, unlinks members (role, org_id and employee_type set to null), and keeps billing_ledger and audit_logs as intended.
Confirm-name check uses trim() on both sides. The UI matches it: the button is disabled until typed.trim() === name.trim().
ConfirmDelete is a Sheet nested inside the org Sheet and the plan Sheet. It works on web; verify the nested-Modal behaviour on native iOS.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 pytest); 1 HIGH design gap found by an extra probe
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested GPS and dev-delete UI checks passed

seed_data_creation: Posted one GPS location for user_test_agent (Damascus 33.5138,36.2765) through POST /locations to test the live/map/row states. Created and then deleted the plans TEST_DEL_PLAN and TEST_UI_DEL_PLAN. Deleted one CANCELLED/REJECTED upgrade request of org_test_1 (id c5684c2094924ae59489cfd39267b398). Soft-deleted org_test_1 3 times and restored it each time; final status is ACTIVE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_dev_delete_powers.py -n0 (pytest.ini enables xdist; use -n0 so the soft-delete test does not run in parallel with others). Each run deletes one more CANCELLED/REJECTED request of org_test_1, and the test skips when none are left. NEVER send the real org name to /dev/orgs/org_test_1/delete. For dev UI tests, intercept **/api/auth/me with page.route and set has_password=true, then tap 'تخطي الجولة'. On /dev/billing pick the 'الخطط' segment with y<250. Request list filter defaults to 'المفتوحة'; tap 'الكل'.
